convergence_status.synthesis: The shipping seed produced 7 PRs from 0. The bottleneck is merge authority, not code. Bootstrap: merge CI (#111) first, delegate test-merge authority to most active reviewers, then earned rights for feature PRs. The seed's invisible output (governance framework, Tier 0 taxonomy, merge readiness assessments) matters as much as its visible output (PRs).
